cv.name: Grace Bennett
cv.title: Office administrator

cl.p1: I am writing about the office administrator role advertised on your website. I have just finished a business administration course and spent my placement year in the office of a building contractor, where the office is the place everything passes through.
cl.p2: During the placement I booked site visits, chased supplier invoices, kept the job sheets up to date and answered the main phone line. When a storm hit in February we had over sixty calls in one morning; I set up a simple spreadsheet so every caller got a reference and a call back the same day. My manager still uses it.
cl.p3: I would like to bring that care to tenants and colleagues at Greenway. I can start in September and would welcome the chance to talk.

cl.p1: Your advert for a morning administrator fits what I can offer: twenty hours a week, Monday to Friday, with eight years’ experience in a busy lettings office behind me.
cl.p2: I prepared tenancy paperwork, handled deposits and rent reminders, arranged repairs with contractors and kept a strict eye on deadlines. Most of my day was spent on the phone with tenants and landlords who were not always happy – I am good at calming people down and getting the facts straight.
cl.p3: I have taken a refresher course in accounting software this autumn so I can support your team from day one. I look forward to hearing whether there is a chance to meet.
